text:
alex: Seeing weird attach hiccups in us-west1 at 02:07 — dozens of GPU attach ops stuck ~15-40s. Looks correlated with local NVMe queue depth spikes.

maria: Yep. Timeline shows a CI artifact GC + janitor tempfile sweep overlapped. Lots of tiny fs ops.

jon: I captured a short iostat from one affected host:
```
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rsec/s wsec/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1 0.00 0.00 230.00 310.00 18400 24800 68.0 5.1 12.3 4.9 88.2
```
This looks like many concurrent small ops driving avgqu up, not a long scrub.

maria: Prometheus shows spikes in node_disk_io_time_seconds_total and kube_pod_container_restarts for some ephemeral reclaimers at the same time.

sre-bot: alert: local_nvme_io_microburst{region="us-west1"} fired at 1759991238

kai: Pattern we saw before but smaller window. Two mitigation ideas:
- Short-window detection (20-60s) to trigger fast mitigations
- Soft-evict low-priority ephemeral pods on a tiny cohort of hosts instead of full drains

jon: I sketched a short-window rule:
```
- alert: LocalNVMeMicroburst
  expr: increase(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device="nvme0n1"}[45s]) > 0.2
  for: 15s
  labels:
    severity: info
  annotations:
    summary: "Local NVMe microburst detected"
```
When it fires, pick 8 hosts in the AZ with the worst AVGQU and evict pods with label reclaim=best-effort.

maria: Also: throttle janitor concurrency per host from 6 -> 2 and add a randomized 0-120s jitter to all sweeps. In our sim that drops microburst probability ~65%.

alex: Cost tradeoff: prewarming spares vs. evictions. Numbers?

maria: Prewarm 40 spares in us-west1 -> ~12% zone cost increase. Canary eviction flow negligible infra cost, small perf impact for a fraction of pods.

jon: Canary plan: implement rule + eviction playbook in staging, then run on 12 hosts in a single AZ for 72h during a low-traffic window. Metrics to collect: attach latency p95/p99, attach-failure rate, avgqu. Roll back if attach failures > 1.5x baseline.

kai: I'll update janitor cron and kubelet disk QoS knobs (lower blkio weight for reclaim=best-effort pods) as a quick stopgap. Need approvals for QoS change—scheduling impact minimal.

alex: Please add runbook steps to #eng-oncall. Important: evictions must not target GPU-launching nodes that are already in the attach path. Keep a tag gpu-attach-safe=true to exclude.

maria: PR incoming: prometheus rule + playbook + janitor cron change. Tagging @jon and @kai for review.

deploy-bot: canary: prometheus-rule pushed to staging at 1759992400

jon: Review done. Kicking canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC for 72h if no objections. I'll collect dashboards and share a short summary.

alex: Thanks all. If the canary looks good, we roll region-wide with staggered AZ start times and keep prewarm as a fallback. :rocket:
